name: education-center
description: Email, calendars, billing, and enrollment for BOS-composed ad hoc workflows.
long_description: Education Operation Center coordinates complex, evidence-backed work across an education company's authorized email, calendars, advertising, enrollment, staffing, and billing systems. Its focused skills can contribute education-domain goals, constraints, evidence requirements, and client work to an ad hoc dynamic workflow; composition and control are owned by BOS when the required authoring and runtime contracts are available. For example, Acme Learning Center could ask it to find Acme.com partnership invoices in its billing inbox, reconcile them against payment records in its configured accounting system, and produce a source-linked exception ledger. Other workflows connect outreach to trials and enrollments, balance camps against registrations and instructor availability, prepare parent communications, and trace advertising outcomes. The plugin requires BOS and each focused skill follows deterministic workflow discovery and execution contracts through BOS with server-enforced application scope while preserving human judgment, approvals, organizational settings, roles, application scope, and provider boundaries.
default_prompts: Initialize my education center, including its customer-facing brand name.
Create today's education center operations plan.
Give me a weekly summary for my director.
